newsitem.title: EGYPT: Amex Bank launching Egyptian mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Amex Bank launching Egyptian mutual fund.

text.p: The Egyptian branch of American Express Bank said on Monday it was launching a 100 million pound ($29 million) mutual fund in Egypt.
The fund, an income and capital growth fund investing in local and international equities and bonds, will be the 13th Cairo-based mutual fund launched in the past three years.
All of them have given high returns, thanks to the steep rise in prices on the Egyptian stock exchange over the period.
American Express said it would put five million pounds of its own money in the mutual fund. Investors must apply for at least five 100-pound units, it added.
The offer opens on March 18 and continues for two months, though the bank can close it after 15 days if it is already fully subscribed at that stage, it said.
The fund will pay income at six-monthly intervals, in April and in October. It will be managed by Hermes Fund Management (HFM).
